sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-146.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 146 was established by Ordinance No. 17753, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 16, 1983. Ordinance No. 17753 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 17753 was amended by Ordinance No. 20641, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 23, 1990, and Ordinance Nos. 21965, 21966, and 21967, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 9, 1994. Ordinance No. 21965 rezoned a 22.6 acre portion of the Property from PD 146 to PD 395. Ordinance No. 21966 rezoned a .275 acre portion of the Property from PD 146 to an MF-1(A) Multifamily District. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17753; 20641; 21965; 21966; 21967; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-146.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 146 is established on property generally located along Pear Ridge Drive, north of Timberglen Road. The size of PD 146 is approximately 56.86725 acres. (Ord. Nos. 21967; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-146.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-146.104.CONCEPTUAL PLAN. A conceptual plan, as approved by the city plan commission, is labelled Exhibit 146A. (Ord. Nos. 17753; 21967; 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-146.105.DEVELOPMENT PLAN.
(a)A development plan for each phase of development must be submitted for plan commission approval prior to the issuance of a building permit. All development plans and their amendments must comply with the approved conceptual plan and the provisions of this article. An amendment to a development plan, other than minor amendments authorized by the director, only requires the approval of the commission. If the commission disapproves a development plan or an amendment to a development plan, the applicant may appeal the decision to the city council.
(b)The portion of the conceptual plan attached to Ordinance No. 17753 relating to Lots 3 and 4 in City Block 1/8738 is replaced by the two development plans labelled Exhibits 146B and 146C. (Ord. Nos. 17753; 21967; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-146.106.USES. The use of the Property is limited to those uses permitted in a Multiple-Family-1 District. (Ord. Nos. 17753; 25508)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-146.107.DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.
(a)Development within the boundaries of this PD must be in accordance with the standards of the MF-1(A) Multifamily District contained in Section 51A-4.116 of Chapter 51A. Carports may be constructed in the minimum side and rear yard, except that no carports may be constructed within the minimum side yard along the east line of Lot 4 in City Block 1/8738 located in Tract II.
(b)The total number of dwelling units on Tract I (25.04 gross acres) may not exceed 630.
(c)The total number of dwelling units on Tract II (31.83 gross acres) may not exceed 730. (Ord. Nos. 21967; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-146.108.PARKING. Parking must be provided in accordance with the requirements of Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 21967; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-146.109.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development and use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and ordinances, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21967; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-146.110.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 17753; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-146.111.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy until there has been full compliance with this article and with the construction codes and all other applicable ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 17753; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-146.112.ZONING MAP. PD 146 is located on Zoning Map Nos. AA-6 and AA-7. (Ord. Nos. 17753; 25508)
